name: Guangauge
description: Set the front hand a shoulder's width ahead of the rear hand so the heavy blade rides level and steady.

name: Single Polebelly
description: Raise the blade high behind the head then haul the rear hand down so the crescent drops on the opponent's guard.

name: Stiff Crescentback
description: Swing the blade low and flat in a wide arc to cut across the opponent's shins.

name: Cresthusk
description: Hold the pole across the chest with the broad blade face outward to stop a straight blow.

name: Stiff Ironsweep
description: Reverse the pole and drive the iron butt spike into the opponent's ribs at close range.

name: Hiltpace
description: Plant the pole's tail in the ground and swing around it to turn away from a charging opponent.

name: Kind Heavyblade
description: Open the feet wider than the shoulders and sink the hips so the blade's weight pulls from the legs.

name: Backward Redtassel
description: Slide the rear foot after the front while dragging the blade tip along the ground to keep the line closed.

name: Hiltstrike
description: Pivot on the front foot a half turn and chop the blade down through the opponent's shoulder line.

name: Loomwedge
description: Angle the pole against an incoming weapon and shove it wide with the lower shaft.

name: Watching Guantang
description: After each cut bring the rear foot under the hips and feel the ground to find the next balanced line.

name: Gentle Tailspike
description: Rest the pole's tail against the hip and balance the blade upright so the weight needs little strength to hold.

name: Wide Guanhook
description: Swing the blade up from low on the strong side so the curved edge climbs through the opponent's guard.

name: Blunt Counterspike
description: Turn the wrists over and bring the blade's back arc across the weak side in a flat slash.

name: Guanwedge
description: Catch an incoming blow on the pole's middle and hold it there long enough to press the attacker away.

name: Hiltblow
description: Slide the pole forward through the front hand and prod the blade tip at the opponent's throat line.

name: Shifting Bladewheel
description: Step back twice while keeping the blade tip forward so the opponent cannot close the distance.

name: Loomcount
description: Let the blade lean on the shoulder during a pause and listen to the opponent's footfalls to read the next move.

name: Straight Heavyswing
description: Throw both arms across the body so the blade travels a wide horizontal wheel at chest height.

name: Downward Rollcut
description: Snap the blade back along the same arc by whipping the lead arm so a second cut follows the first.

name: Lowered Guanpole
description: Spin the pole over the head in loops so the blade and shaft knock away close strikes.

name: Measured Guanhook
description: Lock the elbows against the ribs and set the stance so a hard sweep does not pull the arms loose.

name: Mild Bladecollar
description: Sight along the blade's edge before each swing to confirm the cut will land flat and not on its side.

name: Tuftblow
description: Slide the rear hand to the pole's tail and lunge so the blade tip reaches a full step further.

name: Crescentback Note
description: Lift the blade from the ground to the shoulder in one pull of the legs and back to train its weight.

name: Hiltdrop
description: Drive the whole weight of the blade down through the target in a single heavy arc from overhead.

name: Cresthit
description: Throw the butt end back so the blade head swings forward faster than the arms alone could move it.

name: Leaden Longsweep
description: Slash from the strong shoulder across to the opposite hip turning the whole torso behind the blade.

name: Holding Redtassel
description: Hold the pole upright in front of the body and turn it to meet blows from either side.

name: Fouling Longsweep
description: Hook the curved blade's inner edge behind the opponent's weapon and pull to throw their balance.

name: Short Bladecollar
description: Lunge forward from a deep stance and push the blade's pointed tip straight into the opponent's chest.

name: Light Ironsweep
description: Shift the weight and step wide to the side so the blade stays between the body and the opponent.

name: Kind Polebelly
description: Slide the rear hand along the pole to the butt for long reach and back to the middle for short.

name: Stiff Bladewheel
description: Pull the blade end back past the hip and stab the butt spike forward into a close opponent's belly.

name: Narrow Slashdown
description: Swing the butt spike round in a short arc to clear space when a foe presses against the pole.

name: Lowered Heavyblade
description: Choke the grip near the blade and flick the pole sideways to turn aside a thrust.

name: Shifting Guanpole
description: Step forward as the rear hand slides to the butt so reach grows before the opponent can react.

name: Measured Tailspike
description: Circulate a thin thread of qi along the arms and into the pole so the blade feels lighter in hand.

name: Short Rollcut
description: Send a thread of qi ahead of a straight cut so the blade edge bites the target more cleanly.

name: Square Crescentback
description: Swing the blade in a flat arc while pushing qi into the wrists for added speed.

name: Planted Bladecollar
description: Brace the pole with a pulse of qi and bat an incoming weapon aside.

name: Blunt Heavyswing
description: Drive qi into the front hand as the pole slides forward and the blade tip pierces the target.

name: Swaying Guantang
description: Flow qi into the legs and slide a long pace sideways while the pole stays level.

name: Mild Counterspike
description: Let qi sit in the palms and feel through the shaft how the opponent's weapon presses on the pole.

name: Calm Polebelly
description: Draw one slow breath through the nose and set the stance so the first cut starts with steady qi.

name: Hilthit
description: Release the breath in one push as the blade falls so qi and force land together on the target.

name: Firm Guanpole
description: Draw breath while lifting the blade up through the guard so the rising cut keeps its force.

name: Raised Heavyblade
description: Hold the breath and pour qi into the pole to meet a heavy strike with a firm shaft.

name: Slashdown Trot
description: Step after each cut on a short exhale so the feet follow the blade's travel without delay.

name: Heavyswing Blow
description: Poke the blade tip toward the face on a calm breath to keep the opponent from stepping in.

name: Even Tailspike
description: Draw the blade slowly through the air along the cut line and feel the edge stay flat on the swing.

name: Loomdash
description: Pull the blade straight down the centerline with qi along the edge so it parts the target without twisting.

name: Single Rollcut
description: Flick the wrists upward at the end of a low sweep so the edge scoops up through the target.

name: Hiltlid
description: Catch a thrust on the blade's edge and roll the wrists to turn it off line.

name: Sideways Guantang
description: Slide forward a half pace with the blade held out so its edge stays level to the foe's chest.

name: Soft Counterspike
description: Hold the blade across the front at hip height with qi in the legs ready to move either way.

name: Low Bladewheel
description: Raise and drop the blade in one straight line with qi in the shoulders to cleave the target.

name: Crestblow
description: Turn the hips and swing the blade flat so qi carries it around in a full wheel.

name: Guanhit
description: Flip the blade over at the wrists and cut back across with the curved back toward the target.

name: Guanpause
description: Hook the blade's inner curve over the opponent's weapon and drag it down and aside.

name: Pushing Slashdown
description: Shove the pole's middle against the opponent's weapon with qi in the arms to break their stance.

name: Straight Longsweep
description: Slide the pole through the hands and drive the tip along the shaft line into the target.

name: Hooding Redtassel
description: Step back one pace and angle the pole to cover the body while qi flows to the front hand.

name: Kind Guanpole
description: Stand with the pole upright and the blade high and circulate qi evenly through both arms before any cut.

name: Guanstrike
description: Chop the blade straight down from the shoulder with qi along the edge for a clean safe cut.

name: Loombump
description: Draw the blade across in a modest arc without overreaching so the student stays balanced after the cut.

name: Loomstay
description: Hold the pole level in both hands and push qi into the shaft to meet an incoming blow.

name: Tufthit
description: Extend the blade tip forward by a measured step so the reach stays within the student's balance.

name: Swaying Crescentback
description: Take a short backward step with the blade tip still pointing at the opponent to keep a safe distance.
